rationale: I read the complete held EO 12488 (49 FR 38525, Oct. 1, 1984, signed Sept. 27, 1984): sec. 1 strikes subsection (g) of Section 109 of Part I of Executive Order No. 11157 of June 22, 1964, 'as amended', and inserts a new definition of 'duty involving the servicing of aircraft or missiles with highly toxic fuels or propellants' for hazardous-duty incentive pay; sec. 2 makes it effective Oct. 1, 1983. It has no own term and no savings clause; its text lives only inside EO 11157. I read the held full text of EO 13294 (68 FR 15917, Apr. 1, 2003, signed Mar. 28, 2003, hazardous-duty, aviation career and submarine-duty incentive pay): sec. 1 empowers the Secretaries of Defense, Commerce, HHS and Homeland Security to exercise the 37 U.S.C. 301, 301a and 301c authority without presidential action; sec. 2 states 'Executive Order 11157 of June 22, 1964, as amended, and Executive Order 11800 of August 17, 1974, as amended, are hereby revoked.'; sec. 3 is a no-rights clause. EO 11157 'as amended' includes the Section 109(g) text inserted by EO 12488, so the whole of EO 12488's operative effect ended with its parent; sec. 2 has no exception or savings clause. The machine ACT correctly labels this scope 'whole_via_parent' with names_target false: EO 13294 does not name EO 12488. D6 self-check: I read every other held order that touches EO 11157 Section 109 after EO 12488. EO 12573 (1986) adds a sentence to 109(h) and a new 109(j); EO 12762 (1991) changes 403(a); the American Presidency Project copy of EO 12935 (1994; the held FR extract is neighbouring pages, so I used the APP copy only to exclude a (g) change) changes 303(e) and 401(b). None amends, revives or re-delegates 109(g) after EO 12488, and the earlier replacement of (g) by EO 12477 is itself replaced by EO 12488. No held order amends or revokes EO 13294 or restores EO 11157 (a text search finds no held order naming EO 13294 other than itself). The OFR note 'Amends: EO 11157' agrees; the 1989 snapshot row is empty and in any case predates 2003. Provisional NO hypothesis; the effective end (signing Mar. 28, 2003; no later effective date is stated) is not otherwise adjudicated.
